# Security Requirements Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether the written requirements for authentication boundaries, cluster TLS, command-payload disclosure, and system-table access are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable. This is a requirements-quality review. It does not check that the server enforces those controls.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are system-table access requirements specified for SQL `SELECT`, SQL DML, explicit transactions, and the direct typed API, with a different allowed outcome for each? [Completeness, Spec §US2 scenario 4, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK002 Are system-admin scan guards required on persisted `system.*` tables, virtual `system.*` views, `pg_catalog`, and Kalam-owned `information_schema` relations, or only on a subset of those families? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK003 Are access requirements specified when `system.*` data is reached through a view, subquery, or union rather than a direct scan of the system relation? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK004 Are authorization requirements specified for the direct keyed API used by authentication, jobs, schema registry, and catalog services, including whether those callers are trusted and exempt? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK005 Are cluster authentication and TLS required for every consensus RPC introduced or retained by the OpenRaft upgrade, including vote, append, snapshot, pre-vote, and leadership transfer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK006 Are payload-disclosure limits specified for command display, errors, and logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK007 Are fail-closed requirements specified for a missing user scope, a failed impersonation check, and a shared-table access check that does not apply? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "system-admin" defined as a named role set, including whether impersonation, a superuser, or a service identity qualifies? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §US2 scenario 4, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the denied-access outcome specified as an error, an empty result, or another result, and is that outcome the same for scan, DML, and a nested reference? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §US2 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "enforced in-place" defined so a reader can tell the guard is part of the scan path rather than a removable wrapper? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, Spec §US2 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "cluster authentication and TLS" defined with what must be authenticated, which peers are trusted, and whether an unauthenticated or plaintext peer is refused? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "without printing payload bytes" defined so a length, type name, command kind, or hash is either allowed or forbidden in display, errors, and logs? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the authenticated actor distinguished from table ownership, and is the actor the session user, the role set, or the impersonated user? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec responsibility table]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "target handles are not authorization tokens" defined as a requirement to re-check authorization on reuse, and against which identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do FR-039 and US2 scenario 4 agree that system-admin authorization applies to SQL reads while SQL writes stay rejected? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039, Spec §US2 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the direct-API bypass of the query engine stay consistent with a requirement that those mutations are still authorized, or does the spec treat that API as an internal trust boundary? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-041, Spec §US2 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK017 Do FR-003 and the responsibility table agree that shared ownership never bypasses authorization or impersonation, and that actor identity stays separate from data ownership? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec responsibility table]
- [ ] CHK018 Does FR-050 require TLS and authentication to survive an optional `openraft-multi` adoption, rather than only the current network path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-050, Contract §openraft-multi]
- [ ] CHK019 Do cache-identity requirements include the same principal and authorization facts that the scan guard uses, so a cached plan cannot be reused under a different actor? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-039]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can a reviewer decide that non-admin access to `system.*` is rejected, using a named success criterion rather than only a functional sentence? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-039, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Is there a measurable requirement that shared-table authorization and impersonation still fail closed after the provider change? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK022 Can payload non-disclosure be decided from a stated rule about what text may appear, rather than from an undefined "do not dump" phrase? [Measurability, Spec §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK023 Is preservation of cluster authentication and TLS a pass/fail acceptance condition of the OpenRaft upgrade, with the failure mode named? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-050, Spec §SC-016]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements specified for an unauthenticated session, an authenticated non-admin session, and an admin session reading each system-catalog family? [Coverage, Spec §FR-039, Spec §US2 scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements specified for a system-table read inside a transaction, a prepared statement, and a plan-cache hit warmed by a different principal? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-027, Spec §US6 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements specified for a peer that presents no credentials, an expired credential, or a plaintext connection on the consensus port? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements specified for leadership transfer and pre-vote so those RPCs cannot skip the authentication and TLS requirements that apply to append? [Coverage, Spec §FR-050, Spec §FR-053]
- [ ] CHK028 Is disclosure specified for a failed proposal, a startup diagnostic, and a metrics row, so a command payload cannot appear there either? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-048]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for impersonation of another user during a shared-table read and during a system-table read? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements specified when a reused scan target changes owner, role, or policy between the original check and later use? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements specified for an empty or missing authorization context on a cache hit, so the result fails closed rather than reusing another principal's plan? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements specified for a log or snapshot that contains command bytes when that artifact is displayed, exported, or included in a compatibility fixture? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-048]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Is the assumption that existing session authentication, role storage, and impersonation rules remain authoritative documented, rather than redefined by this feature? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK034 Are cluster credential and TLS configuration requirements identified as existing operational contracts that this upgrade must not weaken? [Dependencies, Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK035 Does the spec state that a performance or unification change cannot remove the system-admin guard or the shared-table authorization check to meet a latency gate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-047, Spec §SC-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Shared-table RLS policy shape is reviewed in `catalog-rls.md`. Raft decode and mixed-version rollout are reviewed in `openraft.md`. This file covers access control, transport authentication, and payload disclosure.
- Items are numbered CHK001–CHK035.
